querySubIssue: Problem using a debit or ATM card
caseNarrative:
ATTEMPTED TO USE AN IN-BRANCH ATM AT CHASE BANK ON XX/XX/XXXX TO WITHDRAW XXXX FROM MY CHASE CHECKING ACCOUNT. AFTER AN EXTENDED WAIT TIME, THE ATM MALFUNCTIONED AND PRINTED OUT A RECEIPT STATING " WE ARENT ABLE TO GIVE CASH RIGHT NOW ''. THE FUNDS WERE LISTED AS WITHDRAWN FROM MY ACCOUNT, BUT THE MONEY I WAS ATTEMPTING TO TAKE OUT OF THE ATM WAS NOT GIVEN. 
I NOTIFIED A BRANCH BANK TELLER, AND THEN CALLED THE PHONE NUMBER ON THE ATM RECEIPT AS REQUESTED. I PROVIDED THE REPRESENTATIVE WITH THE SEQUENCE NUMBER, TERMINAL ID # AND THE DATE AND TIME OF THE TRANSACTION. AFTER CLAIM WAS OPENED, THEY TOLD ME MY FUNDS WOULD BE DEPOSITED BACK TO MY ACCOUNT. 
ON XX/XX/XXXX, THEY DENIED MY CLAIM. AFTER FURTHER INVESTIGATION AND INQUIRY, I WAS TOLD THEY NEEDED THE ATM RECEIPT AND IF I WANTED THEM TO REOPEN THE CASE, TO UPLOAD THE RECEIPT. ON XX/XX/XXXX, THE RECEIPT WAS UPLOADED. NO RESPONSE RECEIVED BACK. 
THE BRANCH MANAGER OF THE CHASE BRANCH WAS CONTACTED, WHO CALLED INTO THE CLAIMS DEPARTMENT. STATED THAT THE ATM AND THE ENTIRE TRANSACTION IS REVIEWABLE ON CAMERA, AND THAT THE FOOTAGE WILL SHOW NO CASH WAS DISPENSED. 
I AM STILL WAITING ON CHASE TO REDEPOSIT MY MONEY DUE TO AN ERROR BY THEIR IN-BRANCH ATM. FURTHERMORE, I FIND IT UNACCEPTABLE THAT THEY REFUSE TO INVESTIGATE CLAIMS SUCH AS THIS UNLESS A RECEIPT FOR THE TRANSACTION IS PROVIDED. 
CAMERAS ARE NOT ONLY IN USE TO PROTECT THE BANK, BUT ALSO THE CONSUMER. IN LIEU OF MY RECEIPT, COULDNT THEY HAVE FIRST REVIEWED THE FOOTAGE? INSTEAD THEY DECLINED THE CLAIM BUT NEVER TOLD ME THEY NEEDED THE RECEIPT. ONCE I WAS TOLD THE RECEIPT WAS THE ISSUE, I HAD NO ISSUE UPLOADING IT - BUT NOW THEY ARE DRAGGING THEIR FEET ON PROVIDING AN APPROPRIATE RESOLUTION.
